notes.title: Meet Suzanne!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39636065/e65fb8321c609741e1213d77d62af0fd20570207.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39636065/e1bcfc90b2d712b3e387199f01ef550ec701f307.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39636065/fdded5f352c7e04029ac9432a9aaa3c2b26ee4e0.png[/img]

notes.title: New games revealed in 2021
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!
2020 made its own adjustments, but finally we revealed 2 new games at once!
Same team, same great artwork and weird sense of humour.

[b]Citybeat: the Sorority Shuffle[/b] is an adult interactive fiction that combines old-school text game mechanics with a modern UI and hand-drawn art. It’s not the most popular genre, but we like it (where are you GoblinBoy?!!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39636065/6bb6529bdd6b645621443a71db798966d87ba21f.png[/img]

[b]Jerry Wanker and the Quest to get Laid[/b] - a classic point-and-click adventure we wanted to create for a long time. Very ambitious project, but we believe it’s time to try on the leisure suit.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1525050/Jerry_Wanker_and_the_Quest_to_get_Laid/

Stay tuned! We hope to announce more news pretty soon.
